title: Authentication Abuse
reward: Learn authentication abuse through cadence and population patterns.
knowledge: Separate brute force, password spraying, ordinary user mistakes and automation retries.
Repeated failures against one account differ from low-rate failures across many accounts.
Success after failures changes interpretation but does not prove compromise without identity/context evidence.
Rate limits and lockouts alter observed behavior.
Never retain credentials, tokens or request bodies as learning memory.
challenge: Contrast brute force and password spraying evidence.
Explain why auth failure count alone is insufficient.
next_requires: Reason about authentication without learning secrets.
